stories.headline: No imminent hike in pump prices despite crude spike
stories.summary: Retail petrol and diesel prices are unlikely to be revised imminently even as the Indian crude basket climbed to $108.91/barrel on September 8, up 13.2% from August, and Brent topped $100 for the first time since July 24. Petrol marketing margins have turned negative at -₹5/litre and diesel losses have widened to -₹23/litre for [[Indian Oil Corporation]], [[Bharat Petroleum Corporation]] and [[Hindustan Petroleum Corporation]], whose combined standalone debt rose 37% quarter-on-quarter to ₹2.3 lakh crore. Officials said a price revision would depend on the crude basket sustaining well above $110/barrel.

stories.headline: Food inflation likely to rise further amid steep prices
stories.summary: Retail prices of onion, sugar, rice and mustard oil have risen sharply year-on-year — onion up 90% to ₹52.66/kg, sugar up 30%, mustard oil up 7.2%, and rice up 7.2% — due to declining production and higher global prices, per the Department of Consumer Affairs' price monitoring cell. The government has started offloading onion from its buffer stock at a subsidised ₹35/kg from October 1 to check further price rises.

stories.headline: CPSEs achieve 40% of FY27 capex target in April-August
stories.summary: Central public sector enterprises and agencies including the Railway Board and NHAI achieved aggregate capex of ₹3.36 lakh crore, or 40% of their annual capex target, in the first five months of FY27, with monthly capex growth of around 5% in August against a robust 35% in July. State-run entities invested ₹8.64 lakh crore in FY26, 110% of their ₹7.85 lakh crore target.

stories.headline: Govt defends GST data against claims of manipulation
stories.summary: The Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs rejected former finance secretary Subhash Chandra Garg's claim that the government manipulated goods and services tax data to show high mop-up, saying Gross GST collections rose 14.8% year-on-year in August while April-August collections rose 11% to ₹10.4 lakh crore. CBIC said the compensation cess was discontinued from September 22, 2025 on most items and comparing tax bases including and excluding cess was "comparing apples and oranges."

stories.headline: PM Modi: 'reform express' to accelerate; India's 7.8% Q1FY27 GDP growth beats forecasts
stories.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi, dedicating the Western Dedicated Freight Corridor and addressing the Global Fintech Fest 2026, said India's "reform express" will move at an even faster pace after the economy grew 7.8% in the June quarter, beating RBI, SBI and Ind-Ra forecasts of 7-8% and outpacing China's 4.3% and Indonesia's 5.3%. Modi highlighted UPI's growth from 1.78 crore transactions in FY17 to 24,162 crore in FY26 — a nearly 13,000-fold rise — and urged fintechs to prioritise cybersecurity and pursue UPI-style expansion into credit, insurance and cross-border payment rails.

stories.headline: Economy doing well, to regain its mojo: Lahiri
stories.summary: Niti Aayog vice-chairman Ashok Kumar Lahiri said the Indian economy has been doing reasonably well and that Asia's third-largest economy will regain its momentum and return to a current-account surplus soon, speaking at the Global Fintech Fest 2026.

stories.headline: Why double deflation matters for measuring real growth
stories.summary: An explainer on India's revised GDP series notes that double deflation — separately adjusting output and input values for price changes — gives a more accurate picture of real economic growth than the single-deflation method, though it requires detailed producer price data that India's discontinued Wholesale Price Index does not fully provide, complicating industry-level estimates.

stories.headline: DoT set to drop plan for taxing mobile data use
stories.summary: The Department of Telecommunications is unlikely to proceed with a proposal to tax mobile data usage — which rose to 285 billion GB in FY26, up 24.5% from FY25 — after technical challenges in implementing a granular usage-based levy and concerns over its impact on digital adoption. The department, tasked with submitting a model by September 30, has concluded a blanket levy would affect productive and non-productive consumption alike.

stories.headline: Trai weighs data-less mobile plans
stories.summary: The Telecom Regulatory Authority of India is moving to finalise rules requiring telecom operators to offer voice-and-SMS-only mobile plans across shorter validity periods, including the widely used 28-day cycle, despite strong opposition from the industry. [[Reliance Jio]], [[Bharti Airtel]] and [[Vodafone Idea]] have separately raised objections, warning that cheaper voice-and-SMS plans could shift subscribers away from bundled data tariffs and undermine digital adoption.

stories.headline: PM-KUSUM to get agrivoltaics component: Joshi
stories.summary: The next phase of the PM-KUSUM solar scheme will carry a dedicated agrivoltaics component enabling farmers to continue farming while also earning from electricity generation, Union new and renewable energy minister Pralhad Joshi said, with the focus on small and marginal farmers, farmer producer organisations, cooperatives and panchayats.

stories.headline: Maharashtra eyes becoming country's first 'tokenised state'
stories.summary: Maharashtra chief minister Devendra Fadnavis said the state is making significant progress towards becoming India's first "tokenised state" through the Maharashtra Digitisation and Exchange of Land Token Asset Act (DELTA Act), a proposed law to create the country's first legal framework for blockchain-based tokenisation of land and immovable property.

stories.headline: Govt orders removal of websites, apps of 15 crypto platforms
stories.summary: The financial intelligence unit-India (FIU-IND) ordered the removal of websites and apps of 15 virtual digital asset service providers — including [[Weex]], [[Blofin]], [[Rezorex]], [[Bitunix]], [[DigiFinex]], [[Toobit]], [[XT.com]], [[Latoken]], [[WOO X]], [[Pionex]], [[ChangeNow]], [[SimpleSwap]], [[Fixedfloat]], [[WhiteBIT]] and [[Guardarian]] — for operating in India without mandatory PMLA registration. The finance ministry said all 15 had allegedly operated without complying with anti-money laundering rules, reporting and record-keeping obligations under the Prevention of Money Laundering Act.

stories.headline: Sebi revises position limits in commodity derivatives
stories.summary: Sebi overhauled position limits for clients in agricultural commodity derivatives and introduced a penalty structure for violations to facilitate ease of doing business. Under the new rules, penalties for breaches of client-level position limits will be calculated based on the extent of the excess position and the number of days the violation persists.

stories.headline: SC sends Cairn's ₹5.25-crore Sebi penalty case back to SAT
stories.summary: The Supreme Court remanded to the Securities Appellate Tribunal a matter in which Sebi imposed a ₹5.25-crore penalty on [[Cairn]], a part of [[Vedanta]], for allegedly making a misleading announcement regarding the buyback of shares in 2014, ruling that SAT had failed to properly examine discrepancies between the NSE's and BSE's version of the historical trading data underlying the case.

stories.headline: DRI seizes 740 kg cannabis, charas in pan-India raids
stories.summary: The Directorate of Revenue Intelligence seized around 740 kg of cannabis and charas — comprising 709.6 kg high-grade ganja, 24.5 kg hydroponic cannabis and 5 kg charas — in pan-India operations and arrested 13 persons, the finance ministry said.

stories.headline: Meta executives depose in child abuse case
stories.summary: Senior executives of [[Meta]], which runs Facebook, Instagram and WhatsApp, appeared before the National Commission for Protection of Child Rights in connection with its inquiry into alleged advertisements related to child sexual exploitative and abuse material on the platform.

stories.summary: [[Bank of Baroda]] issued a Section 13(4) possession notice for a residential plot in Nashik securitised against dues of ₹10,88,40,145.80 owed by Mahaprabhuji Textiles/Dineshchandra Chimanlal Dalia.

stories.summary: [[Union Quality Plastics]] issued notice of its 42nd AGM cum e-voting on September 30, 2026 via video conference.

stories.summary: [[Suba Hotels]] issued notice of its 29th AGM on September 30, 2026 via video conference.

stories.headline: SMFG India Home Finance: SARFAESI e-auction sale notice

stories.headline: Karnavati Finance: 42nd AGM notice
stories.summary: [[Karnavati Finance]] issued notice of its 42nd AGM on September 30, 2026 via video conference, remote e-voting September 27-29.

stories.headline: Odisha Power Transmission Corporation: e-tender notices
stories.summary: [[Odisha Power Transmission Corporation]] invited e-tenders for battery supply, a 400/220/33kV substation EPC contract, dark-fibre leasing and multi-function meter supply, across four separate tender IDs.

stories.headline: Seven Pallets Private Limited vs Dandge Tours and Travels: court summons publication
stories.summary: Seven Pallets Private Limited published court summons in a commercial recovery suit before the Bombay City Civil Court against Dandge Tours and Travels and a guarantor for ₹7,16,714.37 with interest.

stories.headline: Cement majors line up ₹13,000-cr green power push
stories.summary: India's leading cement companies — [[UltraTech Cement]], [[Shree Cement]], [[ACC]], [[Ambuja Cements]], [[Birla Corporation]], [[Dalmia Bharat]] and [[Ramco Cements]], which together account for 65% of India's installed capacity — are set to raise green power capacity nearly 50% to 5.8-6 GW by March 2028 from 4 GW in March 2026, backed by planned investments of ₹11,000-13,000 crore over two years, Icra said, as producers target net-zero emissions over the next 15-20 years.

stories.headline: Banks may have just a minute to spot and stop frauds
stories.summary: Industry executives at the Global Fintech Fest 2026 said banks may need to cut fraud-detection windows to as little as 30 seconds from the traditional 15-minute "golden window," as fraudsters move money through mule accounts at increasing speed. India recorded losses of around ₹22,000 crore from digital fraud in 2025; digital-payment advances fraud rose sharply to ₹40,774 crore, and quick-commerce phishing rates run roughly 4x those of e-commerce.

stories.headline: Call for new lending norms for gig workers
stories.summary: Bankers at the Global Fintech Fest 2026 called for new lending models based on cash flows and alternative data to extend formal credit to gig workers, who lack fixed monthly salaries that traditional underwriting models rely on to assess repayment capacity.

stories.headline: GCCs hit a talent wall
stories.summary: More than half of India's over 2,100 global capability centres plan to expand their workforce in FY27, but a Tagged-CII GCC Talent Lab report finds the hiring challenge is no longer about numbers — 74% of GCCs face critical talent gaps, 48% of critical roles take more than 60 days to fill, and only 42.6% of graduates meet industry employability standards, as executives from [[Accenture]], [[Novo Nordisk]] Global Business Services and [[TransUnion]] GCC India describe a shift from technology-support roles to product engineering, analytics and business functions requiring deep domain expertise.

stories.headline: Business process services shift from RPA to autonomous agentic AI
stories.summary: Business process services firms are moving from traditional robotic process automation to autonomous AI agents capable of analysing data and executing actions, per Gartner estimates at least 15% of day-to-day work decisions will be made autonomously by agentic AI by 2028, reshaping contact centres, insurance claims processing and HR onboarding.

stories.headline: AI adoption widens across factories, insurance and auto-safety testing
stories.summary: AI-backed startup Shodh has developed LUCAN, a model to help industries turn laboratory discoveries into products reliably, having helped a specialty-chemicals company increase output 17% using the same raw material. [[AXA]] partnered with [[Publicis Sapient]] to scale its Global AI Hub for faster, more secure AI deployment, while [[Autoliv]] introduced its Human Body Model Safety Suite, a virtual crash-testing platform being evaluated by [[Toyota]].

stories.headline: Mumbai office realty to clock double-digit growth in 4 yrs
stories.summary: Mumbai's office real estate market is projected to record double-digit growth between 2027 and 2030, at a compound annual growth rate of 12-15%, with residential, industrial and logistics demand expected to expand at CAGRs of 6-8% and 5-8% respectively, according to a CII Real Estate Summit 2026 report.

stories.headline: Coforge chairman OP Bhatt resigns over audit concerns
stories.summary: OP Bhatt, non-executive independent director and chairman of [[Coforge]], resigned with immediate effect after an internal audit flagged disclosure gaps in how the company's recent board evaluation report was prepared and presented, amid a dispute over the report's characterisation of engagement with promoter-linked investor [[Advent International]]. Shares fell as much as 8.7% intraday before closing down 5.24% at ₹1,846.90 on the BSE. Coforge said the resignation was unrelated to its financial statements or operating performance and appointed fellow independent director Vivek Sharma as interim chairman until January 31, 2027. Proxy advisory firm IiAS and governance researcher InGovern Research Services both flagged the episode as a governance red flag warranting close monitoring by minority shareholders.

stories.headline: Hyundai plans to launch mass-market SUV EV
stories.summary: [[Hyundai Motor India]] plans to soon launch a localised mass-market SUV built on a dedicated EV platform, adding to its current EV portfolio of the Ioniq 5 and Creta Electric.

stories.headline: Kalyan Jewellers goes regional to widen buyer base
stories.summary: [[Kalyan Jewellers]] is turning to regional markets to deepen its presence among traditional jewellery consumers, having launched its retail ATM (Akshaya Thanga Maligai) in Tamil Nadu in August ahead of the festive season, with plans to open at least four more ATM outlets in Tamil Nadu over the next six months.

stories.headline: CNAP can't replace caller context: Truecaller
stories.summary: [[Truecaller]] said the government-mandated Calling Name Presentation service may identify who is calling but will not replace the broader context that consumers seek, since CNAP displays only the KYC-registered SIM-holder's name rather than the name of the business or purpose of the call.

stories.headline: CaratLane plans to expand retail footprint in FY27
stories.summary: Omnichannel jewellery retailer [[CaratLane]] said it plans to open five to seven new stores across Eastern India over the coming months and add 40-50 outlets nationally in FY27 to bolster its retail presence.

stories.headline: Bayer CropScience: 'Indian farmer shouldn't be deprived of any technology'
stories.summary: [[Bayer CropScience]] MD and CEO Simon Wiebusch said the company sees no reason an Indian farmer should be deprived of any agricultural technology, citing the need for advances in cotton productivity and crop systems that reduce water usage such as direct-seeded rice, alongside pulses and improved fertiliser usage.

stories.headline: Chand: Need to scale up investments in tech
stories.summary: [[Bank of Baroda]] MD and CEO Debadatta Chand said banks must increase investments in technology, including cybersecurity, given intensifying cyber-risk at the bank level, speaking at the Global Fintech Fest 2026.

stories.headline: AI may not lead to sharp bank job cuts: Chaudhry
stories.summary: [[Axis Bank]] MD and CEO Amitabh Chaudhry said AI's adoption in banking may not necessarily lead to a sharp reduction in banking jobs, though employees would need to reskill as technology changes the nature of jobs, adding that Axis Bank has an appetite for consolidation among banks given the scale required to compete.

stories.headline: Vetri Subramaniam: 'SIP book growth may moderate in next 1-2 yrs'
stories.summary: [[UTI Mutual Fund]] MD and CEO Vetri Subramaniam said growth in the systematic investment plan book will likely moderate over the next couple of years even as primary market inflows help entrepreneurs build businesses that support the economy and earnings growth.

stories.headline: Aadhaar authentication capacity to rise to 250-300mn: UIDAI head
stories.summary: UIDAI chairperson Neelkanth Mishra said the authority is preparing to scale Aadhaar authentication capacity to 250-300 million a day from around 100 million currently, as more than 600 entities now use Aadhaar and the agency works on post-quantum cryptography and AI-based fraud detection for its identity infrastructure.

stories.headline: Adani Airports inks pacts to raise $1 bn for 5.54% stake
stories.summary: [[Adani Airport Holdings]] (AAHL), a subsidiary of [[Adani Enterprises]] and one of India's largest private airport operators, entered binding agreements to raise ₹9,825 crore ($1 billion) in primary equity capital from a consortium comprising Alpha Wave Global, Premji Invest, Temasek and BlackRock-managed funds, across three tranches, valuing AAHL at a pre-money equity valuation of $18 billion. Proceeds will expand and modernise airport infrastructure across AAHL's portfolio, which serves 200 million passengers annually; the deal follows AEL's ₹15,000-crore QIP in July 2026.

stories.headline: Adani Group plans to raise $2.5 bn in offshore debt
stories.summary: [[Adani Group]] is planning to raise $2.5 billion from global lenders to refinance debt used to buy two cement firms, forming part of India's largest offshore loan this year; the facility may be priced at about 150 basis points over the US benchmark Secured Overnight Financing Rate.

stories.headline: L&T secures offshore order of up to ₹5,000-cr from ONGC
stories.summary: [[Larsen & Toubro]]'s energy hydrocarbon arm secured a ₹2,500-5,000-crore offshore order from [[Oil and Natural Gas Corporation]] for the additional development of the Ratna-I (AD-1) and NLM-14 projects off India's west coast, to undertake engineering, procurement, construction, installation and commissioning of three newell-head platforms, a riser platform, subsea pipeline and cable segments.

stories.headline: Nexus forays into Northeast with ₹1,600-cr deal
stories.summary: Listed retail REIT [[Nexus Select Trust]], sponsored by [[Blackstone]] entities, announced its foray into Northeast India through the acquisition of a mall and hotel in Beharampur, Guwahati, for ₹1,600 crore, comprising the upcoming Galaxy Complex — a 0.5-million-sq-ft Nexus Galaxy Mall and a 164-key Hyatt Regency hotel — to be funded through an estimated 40% debt with the balance via fresh unit issuance and unit swap.

stories.headline: Tata Motors ties up with Petronas Lubricants
stories.summary: [[Petronas Lubricants India]] announced signing an initial pact with [[Tata Motors]] for a pilot project on a structured and scalable used automotive lubricant recycling model across Maharashtra and Tamil Nadu.

stories.headline: PhonePe goes global, to begin UAE operations
stories.summary: [[PhonePe]] received its first international licence from the Central Bank of the UAE and will begin operating locally, its first foreign market, allowing it to acquire merchants, deploy point-of-sale devices and offer foreign-exchange services for Indian travellers in the UAE, Singapore, Mauritius, Nepal, Bhutan, Sri Lanka, France, Qatar and Cambodia.

stories.headline: Jio Payment launches cross-border payments
stories.summary: [[Jio Payment Solutions]], a wholly-owned subsidiary of [[Jio Financial Services]], announced the launch of its cross-border payment platform to help Indian exporters accept international payments from global customers and boost their global competitiveness, through virtual accounts, international cards and local payment rails.

stories.headline: NPCI rolls out two agentic AI platforms
stories.summary: [[National Payments Corporation of India]] launched two agentic AI platforms, AiNxt and Agentic Orchestration & Messaging, extending Agentic AI capabilities across enterprise operations and UPI-related processes, and unveiled Fintech Model for India (FiMi) Banking, India's first sovereign compact model designed for retail banking use cases.

stories.headline: IAMAI, Saudi investment ministry sign MoU
stories.summary: The Internet and Mobile Association of India and the Ministry of Investment of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia signed an MoU establishing a framework for deeper cooperation between the fintech, startup and investment ecosystems of India and Saudi Arabia, at the Global Fintech Fest.

stories.headline: MCX, IAMAI ink pact for innovation council
stories.summary: [[Multi Commodity Exchange of India]] and the Internet and Mobile Association of India signed an MoU to constitute a commodity markets innovation council at the Global Fintech Fest.

stories.headline: PayGlocal unveils express checkout experience
stories.summary: [[PayGlocal]] introduced Flash, an express checkout experience allowing international customers to carry verified checkout details across participating Indian merchants without re-entering the same details for subsequent purchases.

stories.headline: IDFC FIRST partners with Sarvam to build R&D Lab
stories.summary: [[IDFC First Bank]] announced a partnership with full-stack AI startup [[Sarvam AI]] to establish a joint R&D lab that will combine Sarvam's AI research with IDFC First's banking expertise, aiming to bring AI research closer to the bank's day-to-day operations.

stories.headline: Yubi launches 'Pye' retail lending platform
stories.summary: [[Yubi]] launched Pye, a new lending platform built for retail borrowers that connects a borrower's application to a network of lending partners at once instead of routing through a single lender, matching each borrower's profile to the best-suited partner.

stories.headline: Kotak Alts exits HKR Roadways, realises ₹1,650-cr from the sale
stories.summary: [[Kotak Alternate Asset Managers]] announced the successful exit from its investment in HKR Roadways through the sale of the company to [[Cube Highways and Infrastructure]] V Pte, made through Kotak Alts' Special Situations strategy, generating over 2x realisation while transforming a stressed infrastructure company into a high-quality operating asset.

stories.headline: L&T first private firm to issue tokenised bond
stories.summary: [[Larsen & Toubro]] became the first private-sector corporate in India to raise ₹500 crore through tokenised bonds with a three-year tenure, under Sebi's newly-introduced blockchain-based tokenisation framework.

stories.headline: Bank of India celebrates 121st foundation day
stories.summary: [[Bank of India]] celebrated its 121st foundation day, commemorating more than 12 decades of service, with celebrations held across its branches bringing together employees, former staff members, pensioners and other stakeholders.

stories.headline: TCS launches India's first fully automated facility in Pune
stories.summary: [[Tata Consultancy Services]] launched what it calls India's first "lights-out" factory lab at its Sahyadri Park campus in Pune, to help manufacturers use AI and robotics to automate factory operations, simulating how self-optimising factories can operate with minimal human intervention by combining AI, robotics, digital twins, plant control systems and real-time operational data.

stories.headline: Asepto sets up plant in Egypt as gateway to global markets
stories.summary: Flexible packaging and solutions company Asepto, part of [[UFlex]]'s liquid packaging business, set up a new manufacturing facility at Ain Sokhna, Egypt, to serve as a strategic gateway to markets across the Common Market for Eastern and Southern Africa, the Greater Arab Free Trade Area and the African Continental Free Trade Area, with total plant capacity of 1.2 billion packs a year.

stories.headline: CIL output rises 40%
stories.summary: State-run [[Coal India]]'s daily coal production jumped 40% to around 1.91 million tonnes on September 8, from an average of 1.36 million tonne during September 1-3, as receding monsoon rains helped restore mining operations and accelerate supplies to power plants.

stories.headline: SIA to seek tougher terms for fresh Air India funding
stories.summary: [[Singapore Airlines]], backed by state-owned investor Temasek, is seeking greater influence over management and stronger governance rights before approving a fresh capital injection into [[Air India]], its majority owner [[Tata Sons]]'s carrier, which is looking to raise around $1.5 billion in fresh equity from its owners after posting a $2.33-billion loss in FY26. The proposed conditions could include greater board-level voting power and measures to narrow Air India's losses, taking into account the group's turnaround strategy.

stories.headline: NSE eyes listing before Sept 25, may trim issue
stories.summary: The [[National Stock Exchange]] could make its stock market debut before September 25, having filed an updated draft red herring prospectus, with the listing likely to follow before that date per a source close to the development; NSE has reportedly lowered the price range to ₹1,700-1,785 per share, below an earlier marketed range of ₹2,000-2,100, and may shrink the stake on offer to about 5.5% raising around ₹24,300 crore, from an originally planned 6%. The offer's sellers include [[State Bank of India]], Mauritius-based MS Strategic (linked to Morgan Stanley), Canada Pension Plan Investment Board and [[Bank of Baroda]], along with four public-sector insurers — [[General Insurance Corporation of India]], [[New India Assurance]], [[National Insurance Company]] and [[United India Insurance]] — collectively selling 148.9 million shares.

stories.headline: Hero Motors Limited sets ₹79-84 price band for main-board IPO
stories.summary: [[Hero Motors]], one of India's leading automotive powertrain-solutions providers serving OEMs including BMW, Ducati and Hero MotoCycle across the US, Europe, India and ASEAN, fixed a price band of ₹79-84 per equity share for its main-board IPO on BSE and NSE, comprising a fresh issue up to ₹6,000 million and an offer for sale up to ₹4,000 million by promoters O P Munjal Holdings and Hero Cycles. Anchor bidding opens September 15, the issue opens September 16 and closes September 18; post-offer market cap is pegged up to ₹3,815 crore at the cap price.

stories.headline: SS Retail Limited sets ₹403-424 price band for main-board IPO
stories.summary: [[SS Retail]], the largest mobile-phone retail chain in West India with 503 stores across five states, fixed a price band of ₹403-424 per equity share for its main-board IPO on BSE and NSE, comprising a fresh issue up to ₹3,600 million and an offer for sale up to ₹1,400 million by promoters and other selling shareholders including Siddharth Gunvant Shah and Rakhi Narendra Firodia. Anchor bidding opens September 15, the issue opens September 16 and closes September 18.

stories.headline: Kheria Autocomp Limited sets ₹96-101 price band for NSE Emerge IPO
stories.summary: [[Kheria Autocomp]], a Gujarat-based auto-ancillary company specialising in plastic injection moulding and sub-assembly components for passenger-vehicle OEMs, fixed a price band of ₹96-101 per equity share for its SME IPO on NSE Emerge, entirely a fresh issue of up to 45,98,400 shares. The anchor portion opens and closes September 16, the issue opens September 17 and closes September 21.

stories.headline: Rentomojo, Karamtara Engineering, LCC Projects IPOs fully subscribed on first day
stories.summary: Six IPOs opened for subscription on September 9, with [[Rentomojo]] (₹1,256-crore issue — ₹150-crore fresh issue plus an OFS of 2.73 crore shares valued at ₹1,106 crore at the upper price band), [[Karamtara Engineering]] (₹875-crore issue, price band ₹241-254) and [[LCC Projects]] (₹427-crore issue, price band ₹139-146) getting fully subscribed on day one. [[Steamhouse India]]'s ₹414-crore issue was subscribed 42%, [[Asset Reconstruction Company (India)]] (Arcil) got 38% for its ₹733-crore, entirely-OFS issue at a price band of ₹132-139 (Arcil gets no proceeds since it's fully an offer-for-sale), and [[Manipal Payment and Identity Solutions]] saw the weakest response at 17%; all six close September 11. Separately, real-estate developer [[Pranav Constructions]]'s ₹351-crore IPO, open September 7-9 at a price band of ₹118-124, was subscribed 121 times on its final day.

stories.headline: Oil breaches $100; stocks, rupee slide
stories.summary: Brent crude breached the $100-a-barrel mark on Wednesday for the first time since July 24 amid escalating hostilities in West Asia, with the Indian crude basket climbing to $108.91/barrel, spooking investors and weakening the rupee, which lost 27 paise (0.29%) to close at 95.10/dollar. The Sensex tanked 813.35 points (1.08%) to close at 74,764.23 while the Nifty fell 203.60 points to 23,431.50, with both benchmarks down 2.29% and 1.95% respectively over the past three sessions. IT stocks led the fall on oil-driven risk-off selling and margin worries, with [[Infosys]], [[Coforge]], [[Tech Mahindra]], [[Wipro]] and [[Tata Consultancy Services]] together contributing over 200 points of the Sensex's decline; US secretary of state Marco Rubio warned Iran will "lose tankers" if it continues targeting US naval assets, and the RBI used currency swaps to manage liquidity and cushion the rupee's slide.

stories.headline: RBI uses currency swaps to reduce cash surplus
stories.summary: The Reserve Bank of India used currency swaps to drain cash from banks, with excess funds in the financial system climbing to a record around ₹11 trillion ($115 billion) following massive inflows under the RBI's recent capital-raising transactions; onshore forward yields rose, and bond and currency traders are watching for further RBI steps to tackle the surplus, with a CRR hike among options being discussed.

stories.headline: US deal may give India tariff edge
stories.summary: The United States may design a tariff architecture that gives India preferential market access vis-a-vis key competitors under a bilateral trade agreement, commerce secretary Rajesh Agrawal said, adding that both sides are discussing an interim BTA that could be the first time a senior Indian government official has confirmed Washington is actively working on one. India's exports to the US grew 3% year-on-year to $34.4 billion in April-July despite delays in the broader trade deal, with commerce and industry minister Piyush Goyal set to visit the US for the G-20 Trade Ministerial in Milwaukee and hold bilateral talks with USTR Jamieson Greer.

stories.headline: Aus flags India's sugarcane support at WTO
stories.summary: Australia stepped up pressure on India at the World Trade Organization, alleging New Delhi's market price support for sugarcane between 2018-19 and 2024-25 was far above the WTO's permitted product-specific support limit of 10% of production, and asked for a formal order or policy clarification under the Agreement on Agriculture.

stories.headline: Freight corridors run at 90%-plus capacity; Western DFC's JNPA link cuts transit time 60%
stories.summary: The dedicated freight corridors have increased combined traffic 15% over the past year to 438 trains a day in August, with the Western corridor handling 210.4 trains a day (87.7% of stated capacity) and the Eastern 227.6 trains a day (94.8%). The newly-completed final Vaitarna-JNPA stretch of the Western DFC gives Jawaharlal Nehru Port double-stacked container capability, cutting freight transit time by up to 60%, though operators say weight/dimension rules cap realised cost savings at 6-7% versus a potential 25%; the combined DFC project cost has ballooned from an original ₹21,140-crore estimate in 2006 to around ₹1.24 trillion.

stories.headline: Cabinet approves ₹20,800-cr rail projects across nine states
stories.summary: The Cabinet approved eight railway multi-tracking projects worth ₹20,804 crore across 31 districts in nine states, adding around 1,196 km of track and around 656 km of new multi-tracking, targeted for completion by FY30 and expected to improve rail connectivity to 6,911 villages with a combined population of nearly 11 million.

stories.headline: MP draws ₹53K-cr investment plan after Dubai visit
stories.summary: Following Madhya Pradesh chief minister Mohan Yadav's visit to Dubai, the state received investment proposals worth more than ₹53,000 crore, following meetings with senior UAE ministers and the leadership of Tatarstan, the World Bank and leading corporations.

stories.headline: Iran, US trade biggest-ever tanker attacks since Feb
stories.summary: Iran said it attacked 10 ships near the Strait of Hormuz on Wednesday, the biggest wave of tit-for-tat attacks on shipping by both sides since the start of the six-month oil war, after the US sank five Iranian oil tankers, killing at least one seafarer and leaving another missing. The US also destroyed five Iranian oil tankers, and the Revolutionary Guards said they would sharply escalate their response to any further attacks, hitting 20 targets if the enemy strikes two or three more.

stories.headline: US says Alibaba, DeepSeek siphoned its AI models
stories.summary: US security agencies accused China's top AI companies, including [[DeepSeek]] and [[Moonshot AI]]'s Kimi, of systematically extracting proprietary knowledge from American firms using a technique called distillation, warning Silicon Valley developers to protect their work; the agencies specifically named DeepSeek, Moonshot AI, [[Alibaba]] Cloud Holding, MiniMax, StepFun and Z.AI. China's foreign ministry rejected the claims as politically motivated.

stories.headline: Dow mulls exit from $20-bn Saudi venture
stories.summary: [[Dow]] is considering plans to exit its $20-billion chemicals partnership with Saudi Aramco, people familiar with the matter said, as part of the US firm's efforts to reshape its portfolio amid a prolonged downturn in the industry.

stories.headline: OpenAI, Samsung partner for next-gen chips
stories.summary: [[OpenAI]] is deepening cooperation with [[Samsung Electronics]] as the ChatGPT maker develops its own chips, expanding ties with the South Korean technology giant across semiconductors and enterprise AI services.

stories.headline: UK gives air traffic provider a week to probe outage
stories.summary: Britain's air traffic control provider NATS has a week to investigate a systems failure that halted flights and stranded hundreds of thousands of passengers, the government said, as pressure mounts on its chief executive.

stories.headline: Airbnb set to face more curbs as EU tightens rules
stories.summary: [[Airbnb]] and other short-term rental companies are set to face more restrictions as the European Commission proposed new rules on Wednesday to help authorities address a housing crunch in tourism hotspots.

stories.headline: Google to invest $15 bn in Finland AI infrastructure
stories.summary: [[Alphabet]]'s [[Google]] will invest at least €13 billion ($15.1 billion) in AI infrastructure in Finland over the next two years, its biggest European investment, including a major bid for the supply of nuclear power, under a 22-year purchase agreement for up to 50% of the energy output of one of the country's two nuclear plants.

stories.headline: SoftBank to repay $40 bn bridge loan for OpenAI stake
stories.summary: [[SoftBank Group]] will repay the balance of a $40-billion bridge loan it signed earlier this year to finance its investment in [[OpenAI]], as the Japanese conglomerate moves with plans to refinance that deal with longer-term debt, paying down the entire outstanding balance of $25.9 billion on September 15.

stories.headline: Amazon raises $6 bn in first sterling bond sale
stories.summary: [[Amazon]] raised £4.25 billion ($5.76 billion) from its first-ever sterling bond sale, slightly more than initially planned, as hyperscalers rush to diversify their funding sources to finance the AI boom, with final demand of more than £10.65 billion for the four-part deal.

stories.headline: US to ban Canadian alcohol, motorcycle, dairy imports
stories.summary: The United States banned a broad swath of Canadian alcoholic beverages, motorcycles and dairy products from import, sharply escalating an already acrimonious trade spat, after Canada's own retaliatory tariffs took effect at midnight Tuesday.

stories.headline: US freezes Cognizant filings for green cards
stories.summary: The US has suspended fresh programme electronic review management (PERM) filings by [[Cognizant]] amid an investigation into alleged fraud and abuse of the country's worker immigration programme, putting the company's green-card sponsorship practices under scrutiny; Cognizant employs around 357,700 people globally including approximately 41,600 in the US and had filed 3,510 H-1B petitions through June 2026, with 3,622 H-1B extensions approved in fiscal 2025.

stories.headline: West Asia on boil again, BRICS sherpas work to bridge divide within
stories.summary: With the war in West Asia flaring up following exchanges of strikes between the US and Iran, BRICS sherpas — the most senior negotiators from the 11 member countries — worked into the midnight hour in New Delhi to hammer out a joint declaration ahead of the 18th BRICS Summit on September 12-13, with Russia's Sergey Lavrov holding direct talks with UAE and Iranian ministers as the crisis in the Strait of Hormuz affects energy economies and sends energy prices soaring.

stories.headline: Anthropic researcher quits citing irresponsible AI use
stories.summary: Jacob Coxon, an AI researcher at [[Anthropic]] who spent three years conducting pretraining research across both [[OpenAI]] and Anthropic, announced his resignation, alleging the leading AI labs are racing toward superintelligence "in an unchecked race" without adequate safeguards, warning on social media that the competitive rush between labs is advancing rapidly towards superhuman systems that "can hack anything, revolutionise any field overnight, and acquire real power and resources."

stories.headline: Building bloc
stories.summary: An editorial on the upcoming BRICS summit argues India believes the grouping has relevance in a multipolar world and can be a voice for the Global South, even as institutional reforms remain needed to align outcomes with member interests, with the New Development Bank a key vehicle for development finance.

stories.headline: India's difficult balancing act
stories.summary: A column on the 18th BRICS Summit argues India must keep its focus on the Global South, open to the world and free from domination by any single country, as it navigates a bloc that is economically powerful but politically divided, with China pushing to internationalise the yuan and expand New Development Bank membership while India resists a common BRICS currency and opposes measures it sees as anti-Western.

stories.headline: Anime superpower needs a bigger stage in Japan
stories.summary: A column on the global success of Japanese anime and manga franchises like Dragon Ball, Pokemon and One Piece argues Japan has been reluctant to build theme parks and large-scale venues around its own intellectual property compared with Disney and Universal, leaving significant economic value on the table as new anime-themed parks are announced in France and Saudi Arabia instead.

stories.headline: When new capital inherits old problems
stories.summary: A column on the Daiichi-Fortis case argues that when ownership of a business changes hands, past conduct must remain open to examination even as a genuinely transformed business should be allowed to build a record of its own, drawing on Supreme Court precedent that responsibility should attach to the person or entity that acted, not merely to the surviving corporate shell.

stories.headline: Letters to the editor: Space developments
stories.summary: A reader letter responding to a prior Financial Express piece on opening India's space sector to private players argues sustained public investment must continue alongside private capital, with a transparent framework for technology transfer, licensing and data-sharing needed to avoid compromising national interests.

stories.headline: Better jobs drive 49% Indians to study abroad
stories.summary: Nearly half of Indian aspirants cite better job opportunities as their primary reason for studying abroad, a upGrad's Transnational Education (TNE) Report 2026 found, based on insights from 53,800 counselled aspirants between January 2025 and June 2026, with 65.8% freshers and nearly 60% of aspirants hailing from tier-II and III cities, and a growing interest in Europe due to rigid immigration policies and rising costs in the US, UK, Canada and Australia.

stories.headline: Messi steps up biz activity with deal for Spanish club
stories.summary: Lionel Messi is set to buy a second Spanish football club as the Argentine star increasingly focuses on his business interests ahead of the winding down of his playing career, with a tentative deal reported to acquire a majority stake in second-division side CE Andorra-linked Eldense; Messi has also founded a club in Argentina called Leones and owns a stake in a Uruguayan club alongside teammate Luis Suarez.
